programme.title: As Estações Das Trutas
programme.desc: Antonio Simões é um reconhecido pescador português que percorre os penhascos da costa galega à procura de sargos. A sua marca de identidade é o uso de uma técnica tradicional baseada nos peões portugueses. Este aparelho permite-lhe pescar à deriva em zonas de correntes fortes e rebentação. Uma proposta que une a tradição lusa à eficácia nas águas bravias da Galiza.

programme.title: American Fishing T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Segunda parte de la entretenida montería celebrada en la finca Casasolilla. Cantidad y calidad refrendadas en un impresionante plantel final.

programme.title: Sargo À Portuguesa
programme.desc: Espanha produz 80 mil toneladas de cortiça por ano, quase 30 mil na Estremadura. 500 mil hectares que geram cerca de 2 mil empregos diretos. El Millarón é uma daquelas propriedades da Extremadura onde a produção de cortiça é o seu valor mais precioso. O montado de sobro alberga também grandes valores naturais, espécies únicas da fauna e flora mediterrânica.

programme.title: A Câmara T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: O rio Bayano é o rio mais longo do Panamá, fica a cerca de uma hora e meia da capital e pode-se lá chegar facilmente de carro, há pessoas que prestam serviços de guia de pesca e têm os seus próprios barcos, tive a sorte de conhecer o Alex, um excelente guia que também pesca numa canoa, o que tornou esta experiência totalmente diferente.

programme.title: Raízes - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Vítor Adão ruma à Guarda em busca das raízes do receituário serrano desta região. A pastora Alcina, o último fazedor de tesouras de tosquia, a cozinheira Fernanda e um especialista na raça jarmelista são os protagonistas nesta viagem plena de sabores.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T2 - Ep. 31
programme.desc: A nossa viajante incansável Verónica Zumalacárregui volta ao Canal com novos episódios de “Comer Pelo Mundo”. Mais uma vez, pela sua mão, iremos conhecer a gastronomia autêntica de cada uma das cidades que visita.Neste episódio Verónica viaja até Madrid.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T2 - Ep. 32
programme.desc: A nossa viajante incansável Verónica Zumalacárregui volta ao Canal com novos episódios de “Comer Pelo Mundo”. Mais uma vez, pela sua mão, iremos conhecer a gastronomia autêntica de cada uma das cidades que visita.Neste episódio Verónica viaja até Israel.

programme.title: Passport Properties T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Marraquexe, Marrocos, revela-se como um sonho sensorial - uma viagem através das cores, do artesanato e da ligação humana. Billy Nash hospeda-se num deslumbrante riad no coração da Medina, é guiado pelos habitantes locais por ruelas estreitas repletas de artesãos que fazem candeeiros, móveis e azulejos.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Em Mafra, Vera Kolodzig e Mafalda Luís de Castro encontram um refúgio pensado para ser partilhado por toda a família, incluindo os companheiros de quatro patas. Um episódio dedicado ao bem-estar, ao descanso e à ligação com a natureza.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Junto ao oceano, Vera Kolodzig e Martim Torres descobrem um espaço onde sustentabilidade e criatividade caminham lado a lado. Uma experiência inspiradora que mostra como é possível viver em maior harmonia com o ambiente.

programme.title: Cozinhas À Medida T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Num ambiente de casa de campo, esta cozinha reinventada alia tradição e ousadia com elegância. O verde suave, os apontamentos dourados e os detalhes clássicos convivem com soluções funcionais e inesperadas, como a ilha com zona de refeições integrada, pensada para acolher toda a família.

programme.title: Cozinhas À Medida T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Neste episódio de “Cozinhas à Medida” mostramos como a simplicidade pode ser a decisão mais ousada: um projeto onde o design refinou, em vez de reinventar, e provou que o verdadeiro luxo está no detalhe, no conforto e na inteligência das soluções.

programme.title: Feito Para Durar T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Andamos há muito tempo à procura de uma mesa de cabeceira de criança que seja diferente, criativa e com personalidade.

programme.title: Feito Para Durar T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Uma cómoda no quarto, também comprada em segunda mão, está funcional, mas pouco trabalhada do ponto de vista decorativo. O objetivo deste episódio é criar um pequeno conjunto que lhe dê presença: um espelho, um tabuleiro e uma peça decorativa.

programme.title: Property Brother: Under Pressure - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Depois de anos separados, Michael e Yuni procuram a primeira casa em comum. Jonathan e Drew ajudam-nos a evitar uma compra arriscada e a encontrar um lar preparado para o futuro.

programme.title: Property Brother: Under Pressure - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Natalia e Ben querem comprar casa, mas a forte concorrência obriga-os a tomar decisões difíceis. Jonathan e Drew ajudam o casal a encontrar um lar que equilibre ambição, orçamento e tranquilidade.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 25
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-sena aventura deos restaurar e transformar em lares desonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-sena aventura deos restaurar e transformar em lares desonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: A família Atkinson visita o griffon de Bruxelas, o Sheltie e o Manchester terrier toy na esperança de encontrar um cachorrinho para crescer com os três filhos pequenos e ajudá-los a ter responsabilidade.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: A família Bhatti está pronta para o seu primeiro cachorrinho. Enquanto visitam o Cairn terrier, o schapendoe e o Yorkie poo, o seu filho pequeno espera que uma destas raças seja um companheiro para si.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: A família Pascoe está pronta para amar outra vez, após a morte recente do seu primeiro cão. Visitam três raças diferentes, mas é difícil escolher. Será o pastor-australiano, o golden retriever ou o branco húngaro de pelo curto?.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T4 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A divisão de tarefas revela-se um problema, quando Bryan e Sarah não concordam com as prioridades da renovação. O escritório de Sarah fica concluído.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T4 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Os Baeumler deparam-se com obstáculos nas obras, ao mesmo tempo que enfrentam uma situação de vida incerta. Os pais de Bryan visitam a Florida.

programme.title: Property Brother: Under Pressure - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Depois de anos separados, Michael e Yuni procuram a primeira casa em comum. Jonathan e Drew ajudam-nos a evitar uma compra arriscada e a encontrar um lar preparado para o futuro.

programme.title: Safe - O Intocável
programme.desc: Mei é uma jovem de memória prodigiosa que tem na cabeça um código numérico que a leva a ser perseguia pelas tríades chinesas, a máfia russa e polícias corruptos de Nova Iorque. Em seu auxílio surge um ex-polícia caído em desgraça que não se vai deter perante nada para a proteger..

programme.title: O Capanga: Vingança
programme.desc: Pat Tate lança-se numa cruzada para vingar a morte violenta do seu amigo durante um assalto, mergulhando no lado negro do Soho nos anos 90.

programme.title: Coriolano
programme.desc: Caius Martius ´Coriolano´, um temido general romano, está em conflito com a cidade de Roma e com os seus concidadãos, e alia-se ao seu jurado inimigo Tullus Aufidius para se vingar.

programme.title: Bolero
programme.desc: A audaciosa dançarina Ida Rubinstein escolhe o compositor Maurice Ravel para compor a música para o seu próximo bailado, e ele acaba por criar o maior sucesso a carreira de ambos: “Bolero”.

programme.title: Medida Provisória
programme.desc: Num futuro distópico, o governo brasileiro decreta uma medida provisória que obriga os cidadãos negros a “regressarem” a África, como forma de reparar os erros cometidos na era da escravatura, o que provoca o caos, protestos e um movimento de resistência que vai inspirar a nação.

programme.title: Diário De Um Romance Passageiro
programme.desc: Uma mãe solteira e um homem casado encontram-se por diversão, sabendo que a sua relação não tem futuro e que não se apaixonarão. Contudo, tudo se vai complicar entre ambos, quando afinal os sentimentos mais fortes começam a surgir.

programme.title: Assim Nasce Uma Estrela
programme.desc: Ester Blodgett é uma jovem cantora que ascende ao estrelato em Hollywood graças ao apoio de Norman Maine, um ator famoso por quem ela se apaixona, que por sua vez se está a afundar no alcoolismo e no esquecimento.

programme.title: True Justice: A Hora de Morrer
programme.desc: A busca pelas malas de viagem com bombas nucleares continua mas agora o antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane suspeita que o seu contacto na CIA esteja a trabalhar contra ele.

programme.title: True Justice: O Fantasma
programme.desc: O antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane está cada vez mais perto do inimigo que todos procuram, o Fantasma, mas quando tudo se parece encaminhar para o fim, o FBI começa a investigar o próprio Kane e os seus métodos de investigação menos convencionais e tudo se complica ainda mais.

programme.title: O Melhor Homem
programme.desc: Um grupo de mercenários toma o controlo do hotel de um resort remoto durante um casamento e cabe ao padrinho, ao noivo e ao seu melhor amigo bêbado tentarem deter os terroristas e salvar os reféns.

programme.title: Preto Ou Branco
programme.desc: Elliott Anderson, recentemente viúvo, fica responsável por cuidar da neta mas é levado a tribunal pela avó paterna, que quer obter a custódia da criança, obrigando as duas famílias a confrontarem-se com os medos e convicções mais profundos no que respeita a raça, perdão e compreensão.

programme.title: Os Empatas
programme.desc: Quando três pais ficam a saber que as suas filhas fizeram um pacto entre si para perderem a virgindade no baile de finalistas, eles iniciam uma missão secreta para boicotarem os seus planos.

programme.title: Chefes Intragáveis
programme.desc: Para Nick, Kurt e Dale, a única coisa que tornaria os seus empregos mais toleráveis seria verem cada um dos seus chefes transformados em poeira. Com umas bebidas a mais e com os conselhos de um ex-prisioneiro, os três amigos concebem um plano para se livrarem dos seus patrões... para sempre.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Num futuro não muito distante, em que as calotas polares derreteram e a maioria do planeta está debaixo de água, um marinheiro mutante luta contra a fome e os fora-da-lei, e acaba a contragosto por aceitar ajudar uma mulher e uma menina a encontrarem terra firme.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: É Só Querer
programme.desc: Após uma vida de estudo, um professor universitário, um explicador e um desempregado continuam sem dinheiro. A solução para os seus problemas pode estar num comprimido, que um deles criou, e que é uma droga que dá uma grande energia mas sem ressaca!

programme.title: O Cadáver De Anna Fritz
programme.desc: Anna Fritz é uma atriz linda e famosa, que acabou de morrer e cujo corpo vai para a morgue. Três jovens decidem ir ver o corpo nu da artista, mas acabam por não resistir à tentação e como resultado mergulham num inferno sem igual, do qual será muito difícil sair.

programme.title: O Rio Do Desejo
programme.desc: Ao apaixonar-se pela misteriosa Anaíra, Dalberto passa a viver na casa que ele divide com os dois irmãos, nas margens do Rio Negro, na Amazónia. Mas quando Dalberto se ausenta para ir numa longa viagem, os desejos proibidos vêm à tona, com todos os irmãos a apaixonarem-se pela mesma mulher.

programme.title: A Brigada Do Reumático
programme.desc: Jack Dundee é um tímido banqueiro de uma cidadezinha da Califórnia, obcecado com o jogo futebol americano que perdeu no liceu por não ter conseguido apanhar uma bola. Agora, 13 anos depois, quer repetir a partida e vai fazer de tudo para recolocar as duas equipas em campo.

programme.title: Pelé: O Nascimento De Uma Lenda
programme.desc: Esta é a extraordinária história do lendário jogador de futebol Pelé, desde a sua infância até se tornar no jovem que, aos 17 anos de idade, marcou o golo decisivo na primeira vitória de sempre do Brasil num Campeonato do Mundo, em 1958.

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos…

programme.title: After: Depois De Tudo
programme.desc: Após terminar a relação com o seu verdadeiro amor, Hardin, agora autor de um livro “best-seller”, viaja até Portugal para tentar redimir-se dos comportamentos que teve no passado.

programme.title: Os Empatas
programme.desc: Quando três pais ficam a saber que as suas filhas fizeram um pacto entre si para perderem a virgindade no baile de finalistas, eles iniciam uma missão secreta para boicotarem os seus planos.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Num futuro não muito distante, em que as calotas polares derreteram e a maioria do planeta está debaixo de água, um marinheiro mutante luta contra a fome e os fora-da-lei, e acaba a contragosto por aceitar ajudar uma mulher e uma menina a encontrarem terra firme.

programme.title: Greenland O Último Refúgio
programme.desc: Uma família luta pela sobrevivência quando um cometa destruidor de planetas chega à Terra. John Garrity, a sua ex-mulher e o seu filho fazem uma perigosa viagem até à sua derradeira esperança de salvação, à medida que a contagem decrescente para o apocalipse global se aproxima do zero.

programme.title: Ascensão De Júpiter
programme.desc: Jupiter Jones é uma jovem empregada de limpeza que encontra um dia Caine, um ex-militar interplanetário geneticamente manipulado, e descobre que ela é a herdeira de uma família da nobreza intergalactica e que tem de proteger os habitantes da Terra de uma ameaça antiga e destrutiva.

programme.title: Plano De Fuga 2: Hades
programme.desc: Anos após a espetacular fuga de Ray Breslin da prisão, um dos elementos da sua nova força de segurança de elite desaparece no interior de uma cadeia ilegal chamada Hades, onde os prisioneiros são forçados a lutar entre si. A única forma de o libertar vai ser entrar lá para dentro também.

programme.title: Safe - O Intocável
programme.desc: Mei é uma jovem de memória prodigiosa que tem na cabeça um código numérico que a leva a ser perseguia pelas tríades chinesas, a máfia russa e polícias corruptos de Nova Iorque. Em seu auxílio surge um ex-polícia caído em desgraça que não se vai deter perante nada para a proteger..

programme.title: O Sobrevivente
programme.desc: Harry Haft é um judeu que sobreviveu ao campo de concentração de Auschwitz lutando com os restantes prisioneiros em violentas batalhas de boxe para evitar a morte. Já em Nova Iorque, ele regressa ao ringue para tentar reencontrar a mulher que ama e aí terá de enfrentar o imbatível Rocky Marciano.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2000 from Berlin
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev (piano), Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Piano Concerto No. 2 in B flat major, Op. 19 - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final: Beethoven and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 36, K. 425
programme.desc: Jeffrey Tate conducts the English Chamber Orchestra in a performance of W. A. Mozart’s “Linzer” Symphony No. 36 (K. 425). The broadcast is directed by János Darvas. Mozart composed the work in 1783, during his short stay in the Austrian town of Linz, on the way home from Vienna to Salzburg. The symphony was written in an impressive span of only four days to accommodate a local concert.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Brahms - Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in a wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, violinist Tedi Papavrami, violist Lyda Chen-Argerich, cellist Mischa Maisky, and pianist Lily Maisky perform Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 31, Op. 110
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: My heart is burning
programme.desc: René Pape perfectly embodies the new generation of opera singers: with a current and relaxed appearance, he craves new challenges and demonstrates an openness to ambitious experimentation. In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. Directed by Sibylle Muth.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 4 BWV 1017
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 1 BWV 1014 is the fourth out of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony.

programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange au Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Preludes and fugues
programme.desc: Compagnia Simona Bucci presents an extraordinary concert in scenic form: 'Preludi e Fughe - Geografia antropica'. Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87 inspired choreographer Simona Bucci to take on this project. Seven dancers of Compagnia Simona Bucci dance to Shostakovich’s Preludes and Fugues Nos. 1, 5, 7, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 24, played by Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda.

programme.title: Liszt Mosaics: Dance Concert
programme.desc: This concert entitled 'Liszt Mosaics' is dedicated to the rich traditonal of Hungarian Folk Music. The concert opens with a selection of Bartók's 44 Duos for 2 Violins (No. 17, 18 and 36) performed by Shlomo Mintz and Radics Ferenc. Furthermore, Pál Eszter is accompanied by the Hungarian State Folk Ensemble and Cameristi della Scala in vocal performances of Hungarian Folk Music from the Kalotaszeg region.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Bruckner's Fifth Symphony has been called the 'Medieval' because of its multi-layered, Baroque, contrapuntal tonal textures and the 'Catholic' because of its solemn majesty. These designations are uniquely fitting to the work, Bruckner himself called it his 'Fantastic,' especially when it is performed at the Monastery of St. Florian, as on this recording.

programme.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
programme.desc: Stefano Demicheli conducts the Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici and soloists Nicola Cianncio (bass) and Catherine Jones (cello) in a varied baroque music program, recorded at Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Seina in Naples, Italy.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 30, Op. 109
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 6 in D major
programme.desc: For the 2016 edition of the Waldbühne, the Georgian violinist Lisa Batiashvili and the Québécois conductor Yannick Nézet-Séguin join the Berliner Philharmoniker for a beautiful concert. They present an all Czech program!

programme.title: Jerusalem International Chamber Music Festival
programme.desc: Having achieved incredible success with consistently sold-out concerts, the Jerusalem International Chamber Music Festival is renowned for its exceptional repertoire of performances by top soloists who otherwise seldom share a stage. This program presents highlights of the 2008 edition, of which the theme centered on the exploration of the “national spirit” of music.

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Galaxymphony Strikes Back
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music.

programme.title: Bellini/Liszt - Réminiscences de Norma S.394
programme.desc: Minsoo Hong (1993, South Korea) performs Liszt’s Sposalizio from Années de Pèlerinage: Deuxième Année (S161/1) and Bellini/Liszt’s Réminiscences de Norma (S394) during the Solo Finals of the11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world.

programme.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s tragic opera Rigoletto (1851). In 1850, Teatro La Fenice commissioned Verdi to compose a new opera. Verdi proposed Victor Hugo’s controversial play Le Roi s'amuse to his librettist Francesco Maria Piave.

programme.title: Europakonzert 1993 - Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: England, my England - II
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer on an intriguing journey through the England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. This performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Mozart and Bartók
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Cello Suite No. 1 in G major, BWV 1007
programme.desc: At St. Bartholomew Church in Dornheim, Germany, where composer Johann Sebastian Bach married his first wife Maria Barbara, renowned Dutch cellist Anner Bijlsma performs the composer's Cello Suite No. 1 in G major, BWV 1007. It is likely Bach wrote his collection of six Suites for unaccompanied cello during the years 1717-1723.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 in D Major, K. 385, recorded at the Nieuwe Kerk, The Hague, in 2020. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 is also known as the “Haffner Symphony”.

programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin’s symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928).

programme.title: Brahms - Clarinet Sonata No. 1, Op. 120
programme.desc: Written in 1894, the two Clarinet Sonatas, Op. 120 are the last chamber music pieces Johannes Brahms composed. In this performance at Het Groene Paviljoen in Baarn, the Netherlands, clarinetist Henk de Graaf and pianist Daniël Wayenberg play Brahms’s Clarinet Sonata No. 1 in F minor, Op. 120.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Works by Smetana, Janácek, Suk and Dvorák
programme.desc: Musicians of the Reina Sofía School of Music pay tribute to the rich musical heritage of Czechia in this chamber concert. The program features Bedrich Smetana’s Piano Trio in G minor, performed by violinist Eduard Kollert, cellist Célia Garetti Nicole, and pianist Mariam Chitanava. Pianist Natalie Schwamova takes the stage for Leoš Janácek’s Piano Sonata 1.X.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Shusha Renaissance (2023)
programme.desc: “Shusha, the Renaissance” is a musical journey featuring pianist Murad Huseynov. The city of Shusha is often considered the cradle of Azerbaijan's music and poetry and one of the leading centres of the Azerbaijani culture, having been declared the cultural capital of Azerbaijan in January 2021. On the program are the following works: Fikret Amirov’s (1922-1984) Twelve Miniatures for Piano Solo: I. Ballade - II. Ashigsayagi – III.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 4, Op. 52
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda performs Frédéric Chopin's technically challenging Ballade No. 4 in F minor, Op. 52. Completed in 1842, this piece is celebrated as a masterpiece within the Romantic piano repertoire, renowned for its intricate structure and profound emotional depth. This performance was recorded at the stunning baroque palace Villa Contarini in Piazzola sul Brenta, Italy, in 2006.

programme.title: Gala from Berlin - 2009
programme.desc: At the gala concert of 2009, the Berlin Philharmonic under its musical director Sir Simon Rattle and Lang Lang present works by two Russian composers. The concert starts with a performance of Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto No. 2 in C minor, Op. 18, one of the composer’s most enduring popular pieces, which demands a virtuoso pianist and a huge supple orchestral sound.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Cinderella 2008
programme.desc: This stunning, new interpretation of Cinderella, is a theatrical ice dancing performance not to be missed.This story of Cinderella focuses on a humble chorus dancer who is thrust into the spotlight, captivates the heart of the most eligible bachelor in town, and despite rival attempts by her stepsisters to steal his heart, shows viewers that true love always triumphs.

programme.title: Roberto Giordano plays Brahms and Beethoven
programme.desc: In this recital, Roberto Giordano plays the Six Pieces for Piano, op. 118 of Brahms, a collection completed in 1893 and dedicated to Clara Schumann who will be the penultimate produced by the composer during his lifetime. The concert program also includes two Beethoven sonatas, the famous Moonlight Sonata No. 14, op. 27, and Sonata No. 31, op. 110, one of the last sonatas signed by the composer.

programme.title: Mozart Gala in Prague
programme.desc: This gala concert at Prague's beautiful Estates Theatre is one of the highlights of Mozart Year 2006. Conducted by Manfred Honeck, the Czech Philharmonic performs W. A. Mozart's finest compositions connected to the city of Prague in general or to the Estates Theatre in particular. Among them is Mozart's Clarinet Concerto, which premiered in Prague in 1791. This 2006 recording features clarinettist Sharon Kam.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.

programme.title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini.

programme.title: Jansons conductcs Stravinsky, Hummel And Beethoven
programme.desc: “Everything about Mariss Jansons exudes joy and sovereignty” raved Süddeutsche Zeitung in January 2018, when the celebrated conductor celebrated his 75th birthday at Munich's Philharmonie am Gasteig with a concert program that centered around the music of Stravinsky, Hummel and Beethoven.

programme.title: The LSO performs Dvorák and Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Antonín Dvorák’s Scherzo Capriccioso in D-flat major, Op. 66, and selections from Act II of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s famous ballet The Nutcracker (1892). Dvorák’s Scherzo Capriccioso (1883) reflects a period of personal crisis for the composer. The work betrays ever-changing moods and a constant sense of inner restlessness.

programme.title: Documentary 2017
programme.desc: This short documentary follows the participants of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians.

programme.title: Concert Live from Geneva
programme.desc: To transcend the political and ideological divides between their respective countries, Daniel Barenboim, an Argentinian Jew and Israel's most famous pianist and conductor, and Edward Said, a Palestinian philosopher and Christian, created the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra, an ensemble of young musicians between the ages of 13 and 26 who have as many Israelis as there are Arabs.

programme.title: Som De Mar
programme.desc: No final de verão, Ulisses é colocado numa pequena cidade perto da costa para ocupar o cargo de professor de literatura. Aí vai descobrir toda a sensualidade do Mediterrâneo através do mar, dos cheiros inquestionáveis da natureza e das deliciosas refeições preparadas por uma bela mulher. O professor apaixona-se por Martina, mas ela já está comprometida e com data marcada de casamento com um rico empresário da região. Numa fatídica...

programme.title: Língua Mãe T4 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: No ‘Língua Mãe’, Carlos Alberto Moniz sai em busca dos autores portugueses. Gente que escreve, compõe, pinta, encena, sempre no seu próprio mundo solitário, por vezes desconhecido de quem não vê TV, rádio, internet, exposições, passagens de modelos ou de quem não tem hábitos de leitura. De Macau a Timor, de Angola a São Tomé e Príncipe, de Cabo Verde a Moçambique, da Guiné ao Brasil, estes autores têm um denominador comum: a língua...

programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente
programme.desc: “Minha Terra, Minha Gente” apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. São empolgantes histórias de vida que personificam o amor à terra. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal. .

programme.title: Feira Semanal: Leiria
programme.desc: Em Leiria, a feira é um verdadeiro ponto de encontro urbano, onde o bulício da cidade dá lugar ao compasso lento da conversa, da escolha, do toque. É uma feira de gente, de rotina e de surpresa. No coração de Leiria, há uma terça-feira que se escreve com cheiros de natureza, sons de pregão e passos apressados entre bancas que já são de casa.

programme.desc: Conversas simples em que cada host convida o seu mundo de pessoas. De 2ª a 6ª Feira às 23h com 45 mins de duração, uma conversa sempre diferente. Esta semana, Rui Maria Pêgo, CONVERSA COM...RITA LOUREIRO.'Figura maior da representação portuguesa, Rita Loureiro é actriz e encenadora. Nasceu em 1969.

programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 68
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 106
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 50
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan And Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: TorTube: Robin Nolan Trio - Swing de Paris
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Ray Charles - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Seven Eleven: Back to the Source
programme.desc: Dutch band Seven Eleven is a mix of funk, jazz and hip hop. Founded in 1987, Seven Eleven is one of the first Dutch bands to perform with rappers, having collaborated with hip hop crew Dope Posse in 1990. Adding a superb horn section to the original line-up, they were awarded the 1993 Camelpop Award.

programme.title: Paolo Tomelleri
programme.desc: Highly acclaimed Italian clarinetist, saxophonist, and bandleader Paolo Tomelleri (1938) is a European master of traditional jazz and swing. With his Big Band, he performs updated recreations of classic swing-era charts made famous by the likes of Benny Goodman and Count Basie.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Richard Bona
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Hi-Fi-Fo-Fum
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Things to Come
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Barbara
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Basin Street Blues
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Hercules Gomes - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist Hércules Gomes.

programme.title: Live at Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Dutch free jazz, jazz rock, and electronic music pioneer Pierre Courbois threw a belated 80th birthday bash at Amsterdam’s renowned BIMhuis in January 2022. Courbois, a celebrated drummer and percussionist, also masters the tabla, conga, bass guitar, and vibraphone, and is a prolific writer with over 100 compositions to his credit.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Scott DuBois Quartet Live In Munich
programme.desc: Rising star of the jazz guitar Scott DuBois leads his quartet, consisting of Gebhard Ullmann (reeds), Thomas Morgan (bass), and Kresten Osgood (drums), in an intimate and atmospheric performance at Munich’s Jazz Club Unterfahrt in March 2016. The group’s telepathy is such that they are able to go from deathly quiet to fiercely avant-garde at the drop of a hat.

programme.title: Birdlike
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Since You're Gone
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Tim Kliphuis and the NCO: The Changing Seasons
programme.desc: The Netherlands Chamber Orchestra commissioned violinist Tim Kliphuis, internationally known for his genre-crossing approach to music, to write a new version of Antonio Vivaldi's ‘Four Seasons’. Kliphuis choose to take improvisation as his starting point; at the same time, he intended to leave the best-known Vivaldi themes and chords in, as they give the piece its wonderful energy.

programme.title: Archie Shepp All Star - Tribute to John Coltrane
programme.desc: In 1960, Archie Shepp attended a concert of John Coltrane at the Five Spot, legendary club of the Lower East Side. Fascinated, he quickly decided to devote himself to the tenor saxophone. Five years later, Shepp - already a staple of free jazz - finally recorded alongside his idol. The result, published in 1966, is called Ascension and still remains today a symbol of free improvisation.

programme.title: Jazzed Out London
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano.

Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is', recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively.

programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano And Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.desc: Angus And Julia Stone are an Australian brother-sister folk-blues group which formed in 2006. Their parents played as a folk duo before Julia and Angus were born. Angus And Julia Stone have released two studio albums, A Book Like This (8 September 2007), which peaked at No. 6 on the ARIA Albums Chart; and Down. Here they perform at The Metro Theatre, in Sydney, Australia, on October 10, 2007.

programme.title: Be Good (Lion's Song)
programme.desc: Unlike many of his fellow jazz cats, vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble. After sustaining a shoulder injury, this former American football player turned to jazz singing. He was discovered in a Californian jazz club by pianist, saxophonist and composer Kamau Kenyatta. Porter lent his vocal skills to gospel choirs across the country and a string of successful musicals before turning his talent to his own compositions.

programme.title: Misc: Jérôme Beaulieu live in Montreal
programme.desc: Modern jazz with a twist, based on a group effort rather than on personal virtuosity: meet Misc! Composer and pianist Jérôme Beaulieu, double bassist Philippe Leduc and drummer William Côté met during their college years at the Université de Montréal. Their Trio Jérôme Beaulieu quickly made a name for itself, winning the Montreal contest Jazz en Rafale and the Grand Prix du Festi-Jazz in Rimouski within the same year.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Shayna Steele
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Seun Kuti And Egypt 80 - Cabaret Sauvage
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti’s legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent.

programme.title: M.Eilertsen Trio And Trio Mediaeval - November Music
programme.desc: The annual international festival November Music was first held in 1993. Since then, the festival has been promoting contemporary music across various locations in the Netherlands city ‘s-Hertogenbosch. Its 2018 edition included jazz, avant-garde, world and electronic music, sound installations, modern opera and theatre, as well as various interdisciplinary performances.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra And Bert Joris - Big Valses
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: How Long Has This Been Going On?
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Sultan Stevenson
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Samba das Flores - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Sienna Jazz
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: Needless to Say
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Enjoy the musical wealth of the All Star Band in this episode of Morgenland Festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Edina Mokus - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Connie Han - jazzahead!
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts. Due to COVID-19, only half of the scheduled performances of the 2021 edition were actually recorded in Bremen.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead!

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Don Cherry's 'Multikulti'
programme.desc: Trumpeter Don Cherry was a musician of great versatility, creating an endless variety of styles and influencing generations of musicians. Multikulti presents a never-before heard mixture of international sounds, from mainstream jazz to reggae, in his first collaboration with the amazing Peter Apfelbaum, one of the most in-demand performers at jazz festivals all over the world.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 42
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features welterweights 'Sugar' Shane Mosley (43-4, 37 KOs) and Luis Collazo (27-2, 13 KOs) fighting over the interim WBC title. This fight took place at the Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on February 10, 2007.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior T7 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: The top Ninja Warrior athletes from Europe, Japan, and USA team up to see who can go the fastest or furthest on the ANW7 Las Vegas Finals course. It's Team Europe vs. Team Japan vs. Team USA.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 24
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Danny Garcia looking to win the WBC super lightweight championship when he squares off with Erik Morales, but Garcia must battle back after suffering a nose injury early on. Also on the card, former world champions Hector Camacho and Adonis Stevenson.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T32 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 2 from Dolphins Areana in Nagoya, Japan features Hakuho, Meisei, Shodai and Takayasu.

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Featuring Women's CMX Form and Weapons and Girl's Weapons at the ISKA US Open from Disney, Orlando, Florida, USA.

programme.title: MMA:30 T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: This episode features a look at how John Alessio, a MMA veteran of almost 20 years, prepares for an upcoming fight. We head inside the kitchen of one of MMA's leading nutritionists, Mike Dolce, to find out what are the approved foods in the Dolce Diet. Melvin Guillard summons his inner daredevil and jumps off the Stratosphere in Las Vegas, plus much more.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA T1 - Ep. 58
programme.desc: Check out exciting action from MMA organizations around the world. This episode features coverage of mixed martial arts in South Africa including two fighters duke it out for the EFC Worldwide Middleweight Championship in Garreth 'Soldier Boy' McLellan vs. Dricus 'Stillknocks' Du Plessis. Bonus coverage includes Texier Kabesa vs. Luke Michael from Durban, South Africa.

programme.title: Capitaine Marleau
programme.desc: Le capitaine Marleau enquête sur le meurtre d'une patineuse artistique. La victime, Lucie Engelberg, serait morte à la suite de coups violents. Pourtant, quelques heures plus tôt la jeune femme s'entraînait encore aux côtés d'une autre vedette de spectacle sur glace, Salomé Revel. Cette dernière, qui figure désormais parmi les suspects, semblait appréhender avec angoisse la fin de sa carrière et s'était blessée lors de la répétition....

programme.title: Capitaine Marleau
programme.desc: Le conducteur d'un train touristique est retrouvé mort. L'homme s'appelle Robert Lanski et était déjà responsable d'un accident ferroviaire qui avait coûté la vie à un adolescent, cinq ans auparavant. Les enquêteurs cherchent à savoir s'il s'agit d'une vengeance. Le Capitaine Marleau soupçonne le prêtre Damien, qui aurait de bonnes raisons d'en vouloir à Lanski. L'homme semble en savoir davantage que ce qu'il prétend et connaît tous...

programme.title: Les Joyaux des Mers du Sud
programme.desc: En Polynésie française, dans l'archipel des Tuamotu, les nuits de pleine lune, des huîtres, les Pinctada Margaritifera, libèrent dans les lagons des millions d'ovules qui donneront un jour, les plus belles perles du monde. Franck Tehaamatai, un des plus importants perliculteurs de Polynésie, a bien voulu ouvrir toutes grandes les portes du lagon afin de partager sa passion des perles.

Ces célébrations rythment l’année et sont attendues par tous les habitants. Voyage au cœur de ces festivités. En Martinique, le carnaval est un pilier de la culture créole. Héritier des temps de l’esclavage, il mêle musique, costumes et satire pour raconter...

programme.title: Une Maison, un Artiste
programme.desc: Réalisateur : Aurélien Drach. Une série documentaire produite par A Prime Group, avec la participation de France Télévisions et avec le soutien du CNC. 2026. Découvrir la maison de ces artistes ou de ces légendes est une invitation, une rencontre, un voyage. Nous allons entrer dans leur intimité de femme ou d'homme, revenir à la source de leurs créations, et partager avec eux quelques moments de leur vie. On croyait tout savoir d'elle....

programme.title: Echappées Belles
programme.desc: Présenté par Ismaël Khelifa. Réalisateur : Damien Pourageaux. Reportages : Sophie Vernet. Série documentaire produite par Bo Travail !, avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2022. A quelques kilomètres du cercle polaire arctique, « l'île de glace et de feu » démontre par la diversité de ses paysages qu'elle mérite amplement son nom. Ces mêmes paysages et ce climat, qui peuvent sembler hostiles pour beaucoup, attirent pourtant...

programme.title: Les Merveilles de l'asie du Sud-Est
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Wildbear Entertainment. 2020. Ecriture : Arika Crotty, Annie Gray. Réalisation : Annie Gray. Cette série propose de découvrir les plus beaux et les plus spectaculaires sites naturels de l'Asie, ainsi que ses monuments. Les épisodes emmènent le téléspectateur à la découverte de 11 pays différents, en passant par des forêts tropicales, des chaînes de montagnes majestueuses, des îles paradisiaques et...

programme.title: I am Martin Parr, le Photographe so British
programme.desc: Documentaire produit par Haut et Court Doc en coproduction avec Avrotros et avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2024. Un film de Lee Shulman Avec la participation à l’écriture de Camille Juza et Benjamin Chevalier Production : Emmanuelle Lepers En 1994, Martin Parr rejoint l’agence Magnum, devenant l’un des photographes les plus emblématiques de son époque. Derrière ses clichés iconiques se trouve un photographe audacieux dont...

programme.title: Le Rêve de Léonard - les Secrets du vol dans la Nature
programme.desc: Documentaire produit par Magneto Presse, avec la participation de France Télévisions et Ushuaïa TV. 2024. Un film de Clément Champiat. Un albatros planant au-dessus des flots, un papillon virevoltant entre les fleurs, une chauve-souris battant des ailes au clair de Lune… Le vol des animaux émerveille les humains depuis l’Antiquité. Au tournant du XVIe siècle, Léonard de Vinci s’est inspiré de leurs prouesses pour imaginer les premières...

Levi tenta intrigar Tadeu com o irmão. Joventino chama Irma para ir com ele para o Pantanal. José Leôncio avisa a Filó que não quer que o filho saiba que tem um irmão. Guta decide sair e Alcides se prepara para ir com ela.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 144
programme.desc: Marta e Cora fazem um acordo. Amanda descobre que Zé está vivo. Bruna conta para José Pedro que Danielle e Maurílio são amantes. Marta pressiona Josué a revelar que Zé está vivo.

programme.desc: O uso de mantras e cânticos para estabelecer uma ligação a planos superiores é algo frequente em todas as culturas ancestrais do mundo.

programme.title: Red - Perigosos
programme.desc: Frank Moses é um agente secreto reformado que vê a sua pacata vida ser interrompida por um assassino profissional que o tenta matar. Ele decide reunir a velha equipa e descobre que a própria CIA os quer eliminar.

programme.title: 24 Horas Para Viver (2017)
programme.desc: Travis Conrad é um antigo soldado de elite devastado pelas trágicas mortes da sua mulher e filho. É então que lhe aparece um amigo do exército, com uma proposta irrecusável, que irá colocar a sua vida em risco e abrir caminho para a redenção...

programme.title: The Gunman - O Atirador
programme.desc: Jim Terrier é um ex-agente governamental cujo passado regressa para o atormentar quando é atraiçoado e se vê no centro de uma conspiração que pretende vê-lo morto. Para sobreviver, Terrier tem de destruir uma poderosa organização mundial.

programme.title: Hansel e Gretel: Caçadores de Bruxas
programme.desc: Depois de terem ganho o gosto à caça às bruxas ainda em crianças, Hansel e Gretel tornam-se grandes vigilantes, determinados a retaliar. Mas sem saberem, os dois irmãos passama ser o alvo e terão de enfrentar um mal ainda maior que bruxas: o passado.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Uma vaga de protestos ocorre em Detroit, no ano de 1967, quando uma operação policial não autorizada provoca a revolta entre a população. Os agentes da autoridade intervêm, mas a justiça da sua forma de atuar é questionável. Baseada em factos reais.

programme.title: Aliados
programme.desc: Em 1942, numa missão mortal atrás das linhas inimigas, o oficial Max Vatan encontra Marianne Beausejour, da Resistência Francesa. Quando voltam a estar juntos, em Londres, a sua relação é ameaçada pelas pressões da Guerra.

programme.title: The Acant - Acerto de Contas
programme.desc: Christian Wolff é um génio matemático que trabalha como contabilista para organizações criminosas. Mas quando o Departamento do Tesouro o começa a investigar, Christian aceita um cliente legítimo que se revela uma ameaça mortal.

programme.title: O Cavaleiro das Trevas Renasce
programme.desc: Passaram-se oito anos desde que Batman desapareceu na noite tornando-se, nesse momento, de herói a fugitivo. Mas o aparecimento de um novo terrorista em Gotham City vai fazer Bruce Wayne sair do seu exílio auto-imposto.

programme.title: Geostorm - Ameaça Global
programme.desc: O sistema construído para proteger a Terra das alterações climáticas está agora a atacá-la e é uma corrida contra o relógio para descobrir a verdadeira ameaça, antes que uma tempestade mundial destrua tudo...e todos.

programme.title: Land of Bad
programme.desc: Uma equipe da Força Delta luta pela sobrevivência enquanto um piloto de drone da Força Aérea se torna seus olhos no céu.

programme.title: Absolvição
programme.desc: Um gângster envelhecido tenta se reconectar com seus filhos e corrigir os erros de seu passado, mas o submundo do crime não afrouxa seu controle de bom grado.

programme.title: Batalha do Pacífico
programme.desc: Quando legiões de criaturas monstruosas, os Kaiju, emergem do mar, inicia-se uma guerra que pode conduzir ao Apocalipse. À beira da derrota, o destino da Humanidade acaba nas mãos de dois heróis improváveis: um ex-piloto e um inexperiente estagiário.

programme.title: Van Damme Implacável
programme.desc: O policial canadense Louis Burke será alocado a uma prisão para investigar alguns assassinatos de prisioneiros. Na prisão, Louis usa o que aprendeu em artes marciais e será capaz de se defender e fazer-se respeitar no mundo violento da prisão.

programme.title: The Outpost
programme.desc: Uma pequena unidade de soldados americanos enfrenta um esmagador ataque coordenado dos Talibãs.

programme.title: Roubo
programme.desc: A CIA recruta um ladrão profissional para invadir uma prisão de alta segurança, no México, e recuperar informações armazenadas no cofre. Mas o chefe de um cartel de droga, com milhões confiscados nesse mesmo cofre, também envia os seus homens...

programme.title: O Iate
programme.desc: Uma festeira tenaz luta para sobreviver depois de três ladrões se apoderarem do seu iate de luxo. Incapaz de escapar e presa no iate em alto mar, ela vira o jogo contra os intrusos e resolve o problema com as próprias mãos.

programme.title: A Bússola Dourada
programme.desc: Num universo paralelo Lyra Belacqua, uma orfã de 12 anos, parte em busca do seu melhor amigo raptado por uma misteriosa organização para experiências científicas. Pelo caminho, irá descobrir o seu verdadeiro destino.

programme.title: Alvin E Os Esquilos: A Grande Aventura
programme.desc: Através de uma série de mal-entendidos, Alvin, Simon e Theodore acreditam que Dave vai para Miami pedir a namorada em casamento e livrar-se deles. Eles têm três dias para impedi-lo e assim evitarem ganhar um terrível meio-irmão.

programme.title: Bell e Sebastião: A Próxima Geração
programme.desc: A última coisa que Sebastien queria, era passar as suas férias de verão nas montanhas com a avó e a tia a tratar das ovelhas. Mas tudo muda para o pequeno citadino, quando este encontra Belle, uma cadela maltratada pelo dono, com quem trava amizade.

programme.title: Barbie
programme.desc: A Barbie e o Ken estão a divertir-se imenso no mundo colorido e aparentemente perfeito da Terra da Barbie. No entanto, quando têm a oportunidade de ir para o mundo real, depressa descobrem as alegrias e os perigos de viver entre os humanos.

programme.title: Black Adam
programme.desc: Quase 5.000 anos após ter sido agraciado com os poderes omnipotentes dos deuses egípcios - e aprisionado com a mesma rapidez - Adão Negro é libertado do seu túmulo terrestre, pronto a desencadear a sua forma única de justiça no mundo moderno.

programme.title: Meg: Tubarão Gigante
programme.desc: A tripulação de um submergível fica presa no fundo do Oceano depois de ser atacada por uma criatura pré-histórica, um tubarão com mais de 20 metros: o Megalodonte. Caberá a Jonas Taylor resgatá-los, um mergulhador que já se encontrou com a criatura.

programme.title: Ben-Hur (2016)
programme.desc: A história épica de Judah Ben-Hur, um príncipe falsamente acusado de traição pelo irmão adotivo. Destituído do seu título e separado da família, Judah é submetido à escravidão. Mas quando regressa em busca de vingança, acaba por encontrar a redenção.

programme.title: The Equalizer 3: Capítulo Final
programme.desc: Robert McCall vê-se em casa no sul da Itália, mas descobre que seus amigos estão sob o controle dos chefes do crime locais. À medida que os eventos se tornam mortais, McCall sabe o que precisa fazer: tornar se o protetor dos amigos enfrentando a máfia.

programme.title: Ameaça Explosiva
programme.desc: Um ex-hacker é forçado a entrar em instituições bancárias de alto nível, outro homem tem de tentar penetrar no edifício armadilhado para tirar o jovem da cadeira quente.

Mais, du jour au lendemain, rideau. Portails, pergolas, volets : des commandes à 5 000, 10 000, 20 000 euros payées, jamais livrées. Remises mirobolantes, ventes forcées, mensonges en série : d'anciens vendeurs...
